followUps.title: Key operational findings

This has moved past a Wiki open question — flagged for direct escalation to JRAR planning. 3. **Drill fleet DR-124/DR-125/DR-139 written out an eighth consecutive bi-weekly deck**, still 0% PA/UA across the full 168-hour week. 4. **Day 24 survey reconciliation posts a small +3.83% positive gap** (the sixth positive reading of the August cycle), but the required forward rate still climbs to 37,044 BCM/day with 7 days left — up from 35,641 BCM/day the pass before, because the daily target itself is growing faster than the gap is closing. 5. **A new data anomaly surfaced on the survey workbook:** the MTD Trucks Volume total (466,767 BCM) is identical between the Day 23 and Day 24 files, even though Day 24 added a real 24,831 BCM of truck volume — the Survey Volume total updated correctly.
